title: electrolyteActivity operation
description: Mean-ionic activity and osmotic coefficients of the salt the CASE's declared thermophysical system carries — the package's own electrolyte surface, exercised directly. Where `pitzerActivity` names its salt by two ions and is the model's bench, this op takes the salt from the declaration and is the PACKAGE's bench: the numbers here are exactly what the flowsheet units will see, which is the point of running it before them.
